Seznam/iROZHLAS say fees will not end from 1 Jan 2027, with final passage in H1 2027 at the earliest (iROZHLAS). The committee is nonetheless already taking it up on 29 Oct. Babiš says the funding will be a mandatory expense with an inflation clause (cap 5%/yr). Pavel criticised the procedure but has not said whether he will veto. Opposition plans Constitutional Court and European Commission complaints.

cs.criterion: ANO, pokud mezi 6:00 a 23:59:59 pražského času 27. října 2026 bude v zahradě Úřadu vlády ČR v Praze odhalena socha česko-slovenského přátelství a Andrej Babiš i Robert Fico budou odhalení osobně přítomni, jak doloží zprávy či fotografie Úřadu vlády ČR, slovenského úřadu vlády, ČTK nebo TASR. NE, pokud se odhalení 27. října neuskuteční (i při odložení či zrušení) nebo pokud některý z premiérů chybí či se účastní jen na dálku nebo prostřednictvím zástupce.

agents.reason_blind: Officially scheduled bilateral event; summit-or-visit slip 0.08, so p_held 0.92. Given it is held, both PMs attending is very likely (~0.94); the small extra risk is Babiš returning late from Algiers the same day.
agents.reason: Signals: no matching market or line. I keep the blind estimate: fixed official programme with slip 0.08, plus a small same-day return risk for Babiš.

agents.reason_blind: ČTK 23 Oct, citing a Government Office press release: Fico visits on Tuesday and unveils the statue in the Straka Academy garden with Babiš, followed by speeches. Officially scheduled, so mainly visit-slip risk (~8%) plus a small risk from Babiš's Algeria trip timing.
agents.reason: Dossier: official Government Office programme, 16:25 arrival and 16:30 unveiling. Babiš's Algiers programme ends with a 9:00 depot visit, which leaves hours of margin on a ~3 h flight, and both items were planned by the same office. The residual risk is a visit slip of ~8% plus a small chance Babiš is late. Signals: no market.

agents.reason_blind: Case against the obvious YES: Babiš flies back from Algiers the same day (9:00 SETRAM visit, ~3 h flight, margin to 16:25 is a few hours but Algerian protocol can stretch), Fico has a record of late domestic cancellations, and the criterion needs both PMs physically present at the unveiling, so a Havlíček- or minister-led reception resolves NO. Both offices published the programme and the statue is tied to the 28 Oct open day, so the ceremony itself is firm. p_held 0.92, p_if_held 0.95.
agents.reason: No matching market or line, so unchanged. Firm official programme on both sides; residual risk is Babiš's same-day return from Algiers and a Fico late cancellation, both counted in p_held 0.92 and the both-present condition p_if_held 0.95.

Anchor: no market; summit-or-visit hold rate 0.92. Small further cut for Babiš's same-day return from Algiers (programme ends 9:00, several hours of margin) and for either PM's possible domestic cancellation.
